name: m_giant_rough
label: Rough M-giant / supergiant linear law (3500-4000 K, log g 0-1.5), approximate
sources: Trend of the Claret & Bloemen 2011 (A&A 529, A75) linear coefficients towards 3500-4000 K and low gravity, extrapolated by eye
notes: APPROXIMATE: to be replaced by table lookups (or MARCS/PHOENIX I(mu) profiles). For the M supergiants the molecular layers (TiO at 900 nm, H2O/CO in the near-IR) make the 'limb' chromatic, which a linear law at the photospheric diameter cannot represent.
